objective: Determine whether CKAD21 5% retention-vs-pooled requirement is close to the attainable score of a non-clairvoyant reference policy informed of the true evaluator family/regime, but never hidden per-episode variables. Identify whether returning-regime failure is a memory-retrieval or near-ceiling decision problem.
oracle_policy: Use only public initial s1, true evaluator family and regime to pick a1 with highest expected probability of s2=0 conditional on hidden/noise distribution. After actual s2, choose a2 matching public causal target as specified by true evaluator family. No instance hidden, transition noise, reward noise, alternate outcomes, future labels or seed/index exposed to decision functions.
independent_control: Separate exact rational enumeration over hidden, public-view flip, transition noise and reward noise must verify the compact oracle at both possible s1 and every family/regime; mean theoretical informed-oracle reward is 113/128=0.8828125.
metrics: Observed oracle reward on exact 3 seeds x6 sessions x96 frozen held episodes. Compare with original CKAD21 context_active, context_random and pooled rewards per seed and session; report oracle-active reward, oracle-pooled reward, returning session3 remaining headroom, required 29/576 successes to exceed pooled by >=5pp, and exact output trace hashes.
falsification: If informed reference oracle fails to reach pooled+29 on the returning cohort, classify CKAD21 frozen 5pp success target as requiring realized outcomes above the expected-optimal informed policy on this fixed sample, NOT mathematically impossible under finite draws or evidence of native superiority. No post-hoc adjustment of original threshold.
negative_controls: No hidden or private noise fields in oracle decision callbacks
Known-world oracle and independently enumerated exact expected-value controller must tie
Score returned from actual rollout, not predicted reward
All original recorded session counts and same cohort namespace checked
No native learner mutation, new original source actions or protected first-use
scope: Isolated read-only synthetic development diagnostic; information-privileged policy is an evaluator reference, not an implementable native learner and not a scientific superiority baseline.
authority: Separate non-overlapping branch from previously qualified PR head, keep active CKAD22 on its own owner path, no PR creation/merge/accepted main edit/native changes/promotion/deployment.
